intro.title: Spiaggia Sabbioni visitor information
intro.description: Spiaggia Sabbioni, also searched as Spiaggia dei Sabbioni, is the best-known free beach in Riva del Garda on Lake Garda. Here you can quickly check photos, parking info, facilities, walking access from town, family suitability and practical details before your visit.
highlights: Free pebble beach with spacious areas
Panoramic views of the Alps and Lake Garda
Close to the historic centre of Riva del Garda
Perfect for swimming, windsurfing and sailing

reviews.title: Spiaggia Sabbioni reviews
reviews.declaration: Ratings and reviews are sourced from Google Maps (last updated: October 2026). The beach currently shows a 4.6/5 rating from 6,465 reviews. Below is a curated selection that highlights scenery, crowd levels, water quality and facilities.

tips.title: Parking, facilities and visitor tips
tips.subtitle: The practical questions people search most before going to Spiaggia Sabbioni

items.title: Best time to visit
items.content: June to September is best for swimming, while May and October are useful if you prefer lighter crowds and mild weather.

items.title: Parking nearby
items.content: There are paid parking options and nearby spaces that let you reach the beach on foot in a few minutes, especially useful in summer.

items.title: How to get there
items.content: You can walk over from the centre of Riva del Garda along the waterfront, and the area is also convenient by bike.

items.title: Beach facilities
items.content: Visitors typically look for restrooms, showers, open relaxation areas and enough space for a full day by the lake.

items.title: Families and children
items.content: Spiaggia Sabbioni is one of the most family-friendly beaches in town thanks to the easy access, generous size and calmer water close to shore.

items.title: What to bring
items.content: Water shoes are useful on the pebbles, along with sunscreen, drinking water and everything you need for a longer beach stop.
